description:
More than 7 years of .NET programming experience on medium to large sized projects is required. More than three years of developing web front ends for large, transactional database applications. Proficient in developing ASP.Net web applications with SQL Server or Oracle RDBMS. 
 

 · At least 3 year of JavaScript programming experience on medium to large sized projects is required. 
 

 · Proficient in the use of C#, CSS, LINQ, Entity Framework, Web API, jQuery, jQuery UI, Backbone and Marionette. 
 

 · Professional experience with Java, PHP, Python, C++, etc. is desired but .Net and SQL experience are an absolute necessity. 
 

 · Candidate must have a minimum of five years of progressive experience as a developer. Project experience must include direct experience developing web and service oriented applications for a large enterprise to include participating in all phases of software development, testing and implementation to include design, coding, and testing intranet and extranet web business applications.

  .Net, JavaScript, AngularJS

 Multiple Openings for GC/Citizen
